note: Savings parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Four capabilities are graded: (1) the single-period daily-balance interest rounding of the discriminating savings account (savings-daily-interest seam); (2) the m_savings_account.status_enum stored value a lifecycle command acknowledgement writes back (savings-account-status seam, approve -> 200 and activate -> 300); (3) the credit a DEPOSIT posting brings to the posted balance (savings-deposit seam and savings-transactions seam); (4) the credit and accumulation an INTEREST_POSTING posting brings to the posted balance (savings-transactions seam). The monthly-posting account (SEED-Savings-Product, product id 1) IS in the graded domain for the running-balance fold of its observed postings (savings-transactions seam): each fold row's amount and running balance are single transcribed fields of savings-account-monthly-raw.json. What stays OUT of the graded domain is the monthly-posting INTEREST CALCULATION capability: the two postings' day counts (30 and 31) are derived from the MANIFEST prose rather than single transcribed capture fields, and neither posting is a discriminating rounding surface.

capabilities.name: daily-balance-interest-rounding
capabilities.description: The single-period daily-balance interest of the discriminating savings account SEED-Savings-Product-Daily (balance 1000.00 MNT at 0.1825%/yr, 365-day year, 1 day), whose raw daily interest 0.005 ties HALF_UP (0.01) against HALF_EVEN (0.00).
capabilities.evidence: Capture savings-account-daily-raw.json under tenant gerege: transaction id 5 (interest posting) wrote back amount 0.010000, the HALF_UP rounding of the MANIFEST's raw daily interest 0.005; the oracle posted 0.01.

capabilities.name: account-status-stored-value
capabilities.description: The m_savings_account.status_enum stored value Fineract writes into the acknowledgement of a lifecycle command on the discriminating savings account (id 2): approve -> 200 (savingsAccountStatusType.approved), activate -> 300 (savingsAccountStatusType.active). The stored value is NOT the Go declaration ordinal (APPROVED is 200, ACTIVE is 300, not 2/3), so a port encoding the enum as an iota silently corrupts status_enum.
capabilities.evidence: Captures savings-daily-approve-raw.json and savings-daily-activate-raw.json under tenant gerege: each command acknowledgement's changes.status field records the resulting status id (200 then 300) and code.

capabilities.name: deposit-credit-balance
capabilities.description: A DEPOSIT posting on a savings account CREDITS the posted balance by its full amount, and the fold starts from a zero opening balance on the account's first row. Each captured account opens with a 1000.00 MNT deposit against a zero balance; the read-backs record runningBalance 1000.000000 straight after the deposit row.
capabilities.evidence: Captures savings-account-daily-raw.json (transaction id 4, the account's first row: amount 1000.000000, runningBalance 1000.000000, entryType CREDIT, date 2026-08-31) and savings-account-monthly-raw.json (transaction id 1: amount 1000.000000, runningBalance 1000.000000, entryType CREDIT, date 2026-07-02) under tenant gerege.

capabilities.name: interest-posting-credit-balance
capabilities.description: An INTEREST_POSTING posting CREDITS the posted balance by its posted (already rounded) amount, and successive postings ACCUMULATE on the running deposit balance rather than replacing it. The daily read-back records 1000.010000 after a 0.010000 posting on a 1000.00 balance; the monthly read-back records 1000.150000 then 1000.310000 after 0.150000 and 0.160000 postings on the same 1000.00 deposit.
capabilities.evidence: Captures savings-account-daily-raw.json (transaction id 5: amount 0.010000, runningBalance 1000.010000, entryType CREDIT) and savings-account-monthly-raw.json (transaction id 3: amount 0.150000, runningBalance 1000.150000; transaction id 2: amount 0.160000, runningBalance 1000.310000) under tenant gerege.

capabilities.name: monthly-posting
capabilities.description: The INTEREST CALCULATION behind the monthly-posting account SEED-Savings-Product (product id 1): postings 0.15 (30 days) and 0.16 (31 days). The day counts are derived from the MANIFEST prose, not single transcribed capture fields, and neither posting ties HALF_UP against HALF_EVEN. The account's observed posting AMOUNTS and running balances ARE graded, but under the deposit-credit-balance and interest-posting-credit-balance capabilities (the savings-transactions seam), not under this calculation capability.
capabilities.evidence: Capture savings-account-monthly-raw.json under tenant gerege: transactions id 2 (0.16) and id 3 (0.15), but no single field records the 30-day/31-day day counts, so promotion does not port them.

capabilities.name: hold-release-available-only
capabilities.description: An AMOUNT_HOLD posting posts a transaction, reduces summary.availableBalance by the held amount and leaves summary.accountBalance (the POSTED balance) unmoved, and its AMOUNT_RELEASE restores available with the posted balance still unmoved. This is CLAUDE.md line 14 as a gradeable cell: the hold is a posting (transaction_type_enum 20, amountHold) that alters available only.
capabilities.evidence: Capture savings-hold-release/ under tenant gerege, savings account 1 (accountNo 000000001): the hold POST (out/savings-hold-holdAmount-raw.json, HTTP 200, resourceId 6) and its read-back (out/savings-hold-after-hold-account-raw.json) record summary.accountBalance 1000.31 (unmoved), summary.availableBalance 863.02, and an AMOUNT_HOLD row (id 6, transactionType.id 20, amountHold, amount 137.29); the release POST (out/savings-hold-releaseAmount-raw.json, HTTP 200, resourceId 7) and its read-back (out/savings-hold-after-release-account-raw.json) record accountBalance 1000.31 and availableBalance 1000.31.

seams.name: savings-daily-interest
seams.description: The daily-posting account read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the single-period daily-balance interest, the discriminating rounding surface.

seams.name: savings-account-status
seams.description: The lifecycle command acknowledgements on the same account, tenant gerege: changes.status.id in the approve ack (200) and the activate ack (300), the m_savings_account.status_enum stored values the oracle wrote for each observed step.

seams.name: savings-deposit
seams.description: The account read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: what a DEPOSIT posting does to the posted balance. The observed surface is the opening row of the discriminating savings account (transaction id 4, amount 1000.000000, entryType CREDIT), the account's FIRST row, whose recorded running balance 1000.000000 pins that the fold credits the deposit in full from a zero opening balance.

seams.name: savings-transactions
seams.description: The append-only read-back of the captured savings accounts, tenant gerege: the per-row derived running balances a deposit and posted interest write into the balance chain. The daily account (000000002) carries a deposit and one interest posting; the monthly account (000000001) carries a deposit and two interest postings. Rows are transcribed in the running-balance chain order the read-back's recorded running balances make.

seams.name: savings-hold-release
seams.description: The hold/release command acknowledgements and account read-backs on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege, savings account 1 (accountNo 000000001): the post-hold and post-release account summaries and the appended AMOUNT_HOLD/AMOUNT_RELEASE transaction rows. Two states are transcribed: after the hold (accountBalance 1000.31, availableBalance 863.02, held 137.29) and after the release (accountBalance 1000.31, availableBalance 1000.31, held 0).

seams.name: savings-hold-net-running-balance
seams.description: The same savings account 1 hold/release read-back read at the STORED running_balance_derived column instead of the summary: the hold-NET, available-shaped per-row chain the oracle writes (SavingsAccount.recalculateDailyBalances). It sees the hold posting depress the chain to 863.02 and the release posting restore it to 1000.31, with account_balance_derived 1000.31 unmoved throughout — the hold algebra of CLAUDE.md line 14 on the stored column, graded alongside the posted balance it does not move.
